bio.text: Bale Dalton is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 7th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.

According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he was born and raised in Central Florida, graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy, and has served in the U.S. Navy and Navy Reserve for over 24 years, including 13 years on active duty, and flew as a Navy helicopter pilot.
He also says he worked for Sen. Bill Nelson helping Florida veterans access care, commanded a Navy special operations support helicopter squadron, and served as NASA Chief of Staff.
